memos.scout:
The honest case for buying POC now is weak, and I'd recommend skipping.

The strongest point in its favor is that the coin is alive, classed ORGANIC with no airdrop dump, and the launch wasn't dominated by a few wallets: the top-3 curve share is 14%, the top-5 post-graduation buyer share is 14%, and 226 distinct buyers came in during the first two minutes. Buyers over the last 15 minutes (588) still outnumber nothing in particular, but they did show up.

Against that, every demand signal is fading. Price is down 62% over the last 15 minutes and 75% from the 30-minute high. Sellers (667) outnumber buyers (588) in that window, sell SOL exceeds buy SOL (519 vs 481), and net flow is negative. Early sell-to-buy ratio was already about 1.04. Bundled wallets hold roughly 59% of the curve, which is a large overhang of coordinated supply. A 1.4-5.1% round trip cost plus 30-second execution lag on a coin falling this fast leaves no margin for error.

There's no case here that demand will still be present in 30-60 minutes. The desk should pass.
